history: All actually visited source poses through each cutoff; best geometric quality view per instance, identity-blind selection. Maximum 128 instances per state; current selected ROIs retained first. No future RGB.
supervision: CityRefer identity is weak referring-expression supervision, not a human visual truth. Target absent => all candidates Unknown. Attribute labels separate. Same-color same-class negatives require an explicitly named observed anchor, target constraint support and candidate geometric contradiction with 10m direction or near<=25m/far>=50m buffers. A relation word alone is insufficient; unresolved stays Unknown.
external: AerialVG geographic-disjoint primary pretraining. RefSegRS source SkyScapes original paper identifies Munich Germany; separate mask-grounding training and transfer comparison. DIOR geographic unresolved => quarantine frozen external-only diagnostics, never transfer weights to official CityNav comparison. No indiscriminate dataset mixing.
selection: Train internal Dev instance R1, family weighted; first best epoch. Thresholds calibrated Dev only; Seen exactly once after freeze.
confidence: Class-balanced Match/Mismatch/Unknown classifier with abstention (City training; original external heads retained unbalanced CE); zero features corrupted Unknown in training; ambiguous observed labels Unknown; unobserved excluded.

fusion.mapping: centroid with actual visited footprint support

stop: Any failed gate: no complete Seen navigation and no Unseen; no residual gain increase, GAT increase, Backbone training or longer unsuccessful training. Geometric credible cases and human audited semantic cases reported separately.
instance_architecture: Full+phrase projections, Word-Patch Attention, causal context reference attention. City heads add zero-initialized full-language-conditioned bias on PUBLIC relative observed-region offsets (no absolute coordinates or target coordinates); all three City arms identical. RGB controls preserve this geometry. No GAT.
confidence_training: External cached heads: feature-zero Unknown sentinel. City heads and all primary evaluations: actual encoded all-black RGB.
